(PER: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ASHOK S. KINAGI) The learned counsel for the petitioner has filed a memo for disposal of the appeal stating that, in view of the compromise between the parties in MFA No.100566/2022 filed by the Insurance Company, this appeal does not survive for consideration.
Accordingly, the appeal may be dismissed as does not survive for consideration.
2. The memo is placed on record.
3. Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed as having rendered infructuous.
